description: Market-data formulas for the blast-infra engine and the SDK: spot price and its canonical string, live supply, market cap, progress, curve and venue trade mapping, USD stamps, candles and position accounting. Contract-produced values come from the scenarios, which sui/launchpad/tests/market_data_vectors_tests.move proves through the launchpad.

units.price: quote atoms per meme atom; price strings are the exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits, with no exponent, no trailing fractional zeros and at least one digit before the point
units.usd: decimal strings truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits (integers in units of 10^-18 USD)
units.time: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC; Pyth publish_time in seconds

kinds.curve_price: given virtual_quote, real_quote_reserve, meme_reserve; expect price, price_exact_rational (null without a price)
kinds.venue_price: given sqrt_price_x64, meme_is_coin_a; expect price, price_exact_rational
kinds.live_supply: given path, supply_mode, before, change; expect after and live_supply = currency_supply - pending_burn_total - balance_0x0
kinds.market_cap: given live_supply, price_exact_rational; expect market_cap = floor(live_supply x price)
kinds.progress: given real_quote_reserve, graduation_target, lifecycle; expect progress_bps
kinds.curve_trade: given the Bought or Sold fields; expect kind, side, trader (sender, or null for the opening-round pot), amounts, fees, price and progress after
kinds.opening_round_fill: given the OpeningRoundDelivered fields; expect the bidder's fill (or null when it delivers no meme)
kinds.venue_trade: given a swap; expect side, amounts, fees and prices before and after
kinds.usd_stamp: given the trade, its cursor and the Pyth updates; expect the stamp and volume_usd
kinds.candles: given trades and the previous close; expect the candles of one interval
kinds.candle_derivation: given candles of the source interval; expect the derived interval
kinds.position: given per-transaction balance deltas and trades; expect the position after each transaction

cases.name: curve trade: pre-share buy
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; fees: protocol + creator deltas; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits

cases.name: curve trade: buy
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; fees: protocol + creator deltas; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits
cases.notes: quote_amount is the accepted gross quote; the refund is not in it.

cases.name: curve trade: sell with a burn
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; fees: protocol + creator deltas; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits

cases.name: curve trade: second sell

cases.name: curve trade: capped graduation buy
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; fees: protocol + creator deltas; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits

cases.name: curve trade: opening-round settlement
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; fees: protocol + creator deltas; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits

cases.name: opening-round fill: delivery to ALICE
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; the contract rounds each share down and the last delivery takes the remainder
cases.notes: Contract-produced delivery. The fill is the bidder's whoever delivers it; its price and USD stamp are the settlement trade's.

cases.name: opening-round fill: delivery to BOB
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; the contract rounds each share down and the last delivery takes the remainder
cases.notes: Contract-produced delivery. The fill is the bidder's whoever delivers it; its price and USD stamp are the settlement trade's.

cases.name: opening-round fill: delivery to LAUNCHER
cases.rounding: amounts: exact event fields; the contract rounds each share down and the last delivery takes the remainder

cases.name: opening-round fill: a delivery with no meme is no trade

cases.notes: A pot too small to buy one meme atom is refunded whole: the delivery returns the bid and is no trade.

cases.name: an update in an earlier transaction of the same checkpoint is used

cases.notes: The same-checkpoint update at transaction slot 2 precedes the trade at slot 4.

cases.name: an update in a later transaction is not used
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: The update at slot 7 comes after the trade; the earlier checkpoint's update stamps it.

cases.name: no earlier price gives a null stamp
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: The only update follows the trade.

cases.name: an update earlier in the same transaction is used
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: Event order within a transaction counts.

cases.name: one quote atom
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: One quote atom: 3.4521 x 10^-9 USD, exact.

cases.name: volume_usd truncates toward zero at 18 digits
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: Exactly 0.0121932631112635269 USD: 19 fractional digits, the 19th a 9. Truncation keeps ...526; rounding would give ...527.

cases.name: updates are ordered by cursor as a numeric tuple
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: Listed out of order. Slot 10 is the latest before slot 11; comparing cursors as text would pick slot 9.

cases.name: a 6-decimal quote
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0

cases.name: a zero-decimal quote at one cent
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0

cases.name: a positive exponent
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: 300 USD a unit (3 x 10^2), times 2.000000001 units: exact 600.0000003.

cases.name: age_ms is floored at 0
cases.rounding: volume_usd: quote_amount x price x 10^expo / 10^quote_decimals, truncated toward zero at 18 fractional digits; the stamp is the latest update whose cursor precedes the trade's; age_ms is floored at 0
cases.notes: Pyth's publish time (1_790_300_002 s) is after the checkpoint (1_790_300_000.123 s), a clock difference between Pyth and Sui; the age is 0, not -1877.

cases.name: 1m candles across minutes, midnight and a new week
cases.rounding: bucket: [start, start + interval) by checkpoint time in UTC; prices: exact extremes, truncated strings; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits
cases.notes: open is the previous candle's close (O-12), or the first trade's price for the pool's first candle; high and low include the open, so every bar contains it; an empty bucket has no candle; a trade without a USD stamp is left out of volume_usd, which is null only when no trade in the bucket has one.

cases.name: 1m candles continuing an earlier close
cases.rounding: bucket: [start, start + interval) by checkpoint time in UTC; prices: exact extremes, truncated strings; price: exact ratio truncated toward zero at 36 fractional digits
cases.notes: The first candle opens at the given previous close, above every trade, so its high is the open.

cases.name: 5m candles derived from 1m
cases.rounding: merge: first open, last close, max high, min low, sums; a null volume_usd adds nothing
cases.notes: Equal to building the interval directly from the trades.

cases.name: 15m candles derived from 1m
cases.rounding: merge: first open, last close, max high, min low, sums; a null volume_usd adds nothing
cases.notes: Equal to building the interval directly from the trades.

cases.name: 1h candles derived from 1m
cases.rounding: merge: first open, last close, max high, min low, sums; a null volume_usd adds nothing
cases.notes: Equal to building the interval directly from the trades.

cases.name: 4h candles derived from 1m
cases.rounding: merge: first open, last close, max high, min low, sums; a null volume_usd adds nothing
cases.notes: Equal to building the interval directly from the trades.

cases.name: 1w candles derived from 1d, weeks starting Monday 00:00 UTC
cases.rounding: merge: first open, last close, max high, min low, sums; a null volume_usd adds nothing
cases.notes: 1d candles are stored; 1w derives from them. The Sunday trades and the Monday trades fall in different weeks.

cases.name: position: buys only
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: Two buys add up; nothing is realized. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a partial sell
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: A third of q leaves at average cost, floored. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a full exit
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: Selling all of q removes the whole cost, with no rounding residue. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a transfer in, then a sell larger than q
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: Received tokens are not traded: only q of the sell has a cost and a gain; the rest records none. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a transfer out
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: Sending traded tokens away removes their cost with no gain or loss. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a buy and a send-away in one transaction
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: x = delta - t is negative: the send leaves after the buy, at the new average cost. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a claim and a sell in one transaction
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: x is positive: the claimed tokens are received, and the sell takes traded tokens first. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: a curve buy, then a sell on the migration pool
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: Positions are per coin across its pools. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: an unstamped buy
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: The unstamped buy adds quote cost but no USD cost, and the position is USD-incomplete from then on. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: an opening-round fill delivered by someone else, then a sell
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: TA-8: the delivery is the bidder's trade whoever sends it, so x = delta - t is 0 and nothing counts as received. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.

cases.name: position: the rounding edge where y < q
cases.rounding: cost removal: floor(cost x y / q) per currency unless y = q; partial proceeds: floor(p x y / m); USD in units of 10^-18
cases.notes: floor(cost x y / q) per currency; the remainder stays with q. A trade without a USD stamp changes the quote values, removes USD cost at average cost, realizes no USD, and sets usd_complete to false.
